comment: The table that picks a glyph set from the name of a gamepad (D-711). Godot reports no controller type, so Game reads the name of the pad and this table names the glyphs (F-50). The rules run in the order of this file, and the first rule that holds wins. A name that no rule matches takes the default set. Under Steam, PR-78 asks Steamworks for the controller type and overrides this pick (D-460, D-553).
